layout.notebook_first:
All systems are green. The engines only need the captain's card. The captain went down to the engine room and never came back.
If you are reading this, the circuit board got you off the bridge too. What you carry decides where a door leads.

notes.text: The duct tape only shows up for someone carrying the coolant valve.
The dog tag is junk. The doors don't care about it.
Looked everywhere for the voice recorder. It was never there until I picked up the coolant valve and the duct tape.
I walked these rooms for hours before I got it. Carry the duct tape and the doors let you go.
You won't find the voice recorder unless you carry the coolant valve and the duct tape. Don't ask me how I know.
The engine room answers to three things: the coolant valve, the duct tape and the voice recorder. Keep the notebook. The circuit board has done its job. Let it go.

He never made it back. You will. The notebook, the card, nothing else - and any door is the bridge.
I carried the circuit board and the flashlight through a door. The room behind it nearly killed me.
